```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# Reproducibility
set.seed(1)

############################################################
# 0) Clear R "brain" + libraries
############################################################
rm(list = ls())
gc()

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(lubridate)
  library(tibble)   # for glimpse()
  library(ggplot2)
})


############################################################
# 1) Set working directory (analysis folder)
############################################################
setwd("/SynologyDrive/PhD/Projects/SpringBloom2021/DataAnalysis_SpringBloom2021/Supplementary/FunctionalOverlap/")

# Load the color palette
source("ColorPalette.R")

############################################################
# 2) Load exported analysis tables (from the preparation script)
############################################################

species_meta      <- readr::read_csv("../../Figure_03/LakeOverview/Species_Meta_Table.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
species_abundance <- readr::read_csv("../../Figure_03/LakeOverview/Species_Abundance_Table.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
gene_table        <- readr::read_csv("../../Figure_03/LakeOverview/Species_Gene_Table.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
protein_table     <- readr::read_csv("../../Figure_03/LakeOverview/Species_Protein_Table.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

############################################################
# 3) Quick look
############################################################
glimpse(species_meta)
glimpse(species_abundance)
glimpse(gene_table)
glimpse(protein_table)

############################################################
# 4) Ensure Date columns are Date class (robust to CSV parsing)
############################################################
if ("Date" %in% names(species_abundance)) {
  species_abundance <- species_abundance %>% mutate(Date = as.Date(Date))
}
if ("Date" %in% names(protein_table)) {
  protein_table <- protein_table %>% mutate(Date = as.Date(Date))
}
```


```{r}
############################################################
# SUPPLEMENTARY FIGURE 31
# Functional KEGG overlap across trophic strategies
#
# Same functional module definitions and >=5-date
# protein-detection rule as the main analysis.
############################################################

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
  library(readr)
})


############################################################
# 1) SETTINGS
############################################################

detection_filter <- 5

groups_use <- c(
  "Oligotroph",
  "Intermediate",
  "Copiotroph"
)

modules_focus <- c(
  "Core metabolism/biosynthesis",
  "Resource acquisition",
  "Growth machinery"
)

comparison_order <- c(
  "Oligotroph–Intermediate",
  "Oligotroph–Copiotroph",
  "Intermediate–Copiotroph"
)

recode_group <- function(x) {
  recode(
    as.character(x),
    "Oligo_like" = "Oligotroph",
    "Copio_like" = "Copiotroph",
    .default = as.character(x)
  )
}


############################################################
# 2) EXACT FUNCTIONAL MODULE DEFINITIONS
#    Same classification as main analysis
############################################################

module_map <- tribble(
  ~Label,                                    ~Module,

  # Resource acquisition
  "Transporters",                             "Resource acquisition",
  "Secretion system",                         "Resource acquisition",
  "Two-component system",                     "Resource acquisition",
  "Membrane trafficking",                     "Resource acquisition",
  "Ion channels",                             "Resource acquisition",
  "Lectins",                                  "Resource acquisition",

  # Growth machinery
  "Ribosome",                                 "Growth machinery",
  "Ribosome biogenesis",                      "Growth machinery",
  "Translation factors",                      "Growth machinery",
  "Transfer RNA biogenesis",                  "Growth machinery",

  # Core metabolism / biosynthesis
  "Enzymes",                                  "Core metabolism/biosynthesis",
  "Amino acid related enzymes",               "Core metabolism/biosynthesis",
  "Lipid biosynthesis proteins",              "Core metabolism/biosynthesis",
  "Lipopolysaccharide biosynthesis proteins", "Core metabolism/biosynthesis",
  "Glycosyltransferases",                     "Core metabolism/biosynthesis",
  "Polyketide biosynthesis proteins",         "Core metabolism/biosynthesis",
  "Prenyltransferases",                       "Core metabolism/biosynthesis",
  "Cytochrome P450",                          "Core metabolism/biosynthesis"
)


############################################################
# 3) GENOMIC KEGG REPERTOIRE
#
# Unique KEGG IDs encoded within each trophic strategy.
# Collapse first for speed.
############################################################

genes_long <- gene_table %>%
  transmute(
    Group = recode_group(Group_For_Plots),
    KEGG_ID,
    KEGG_Subcategory
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Group %in% groups_use,
    !is.na(KEGG_ID),
    KEGG_ID != "",
    KEGG_ID != "Unclassified",
    !is.na(KEGG_Subcategory)
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    .sub = str_replace_all(
      KEGG_Subcategory,
      "\\s*;\\s*",
      ";"
    )
  ) %>%
  separate_rows(.sub, sep = ";") %>%
  mutate(
    Label = str_trim(.sub)
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    module_map,
    by = "Label"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Module %in% modules_focus
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    Group,
    Module,
    KEGG_ID
  )


############################################################
# 4) PROTEINS DETECTED ON >=5 SAMPLING DATES
#
# Same rule as main analysis:
# each Species_ID x Protein_ID must have normalized iBAQ > 0
# on at least 5 dates.
############################################################

prot_expr <- protein_table %>%
  mutate(
    Group = recode_group(Group_For_Plots),
    detected = Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm > 0
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Group %in% groups_use
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    Species_ID,
    Protein_ID,
    Group
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_dates_detected = sum(
      detected,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    n_dates_detected >= detection_filter
  )


############################################################
# 5) ANNOTATE ONLY RETAINED PROTEINS WITH KEGG
############################################################

protein_annotation <- gene_table %>%
  semi_join(
    prot_expr,
    by = c(
      "Species_ID",
      "Protein_ID"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Species_ID,
    Protein_ID,
    KEGG_ID,
    KEGG_Subcategory
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(KEGG_ID),
    KEGG_ID != "",
    KEGG_ID != "Unclassified",
    !is.na(KEGG_Subcategory)
  ) %>%
  distinct()


proteins_long <- prot_expr %>%
  inner_join(
    protein_annotation,
    by = c(
      "Species_ID",
      "Protein_ID"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    .sub = str_replace_all(
      KEGG_Subcategory,
      "\\s*;\\s*",
      ";"
    )
  ) %>%
  separate_rows(.sub, sep = ";") %>%
  mutate(
    Label = str_trim(.sub)
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    module_map,
    by = "Label"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Module %in% modules_focus
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    Group,
    Module,
    KEGG_ID
  )


############################################################
# 6) PAIRWISE FUNCTIONAL OVERLAP
############################################################

compare_pair <- function(g1, g2) {

  bind_rows(
    lapply(
      modules_focus,
      function(mod) {

        # Genomically encoded KEGG repertoires
        G1 <- genes_long %>%
          filter(Group == g1, Module == mod) %>%
          pull(KEGG_ID)

        G2 <- genes_long %>%
          filter(Group == g2, Module == mod) %>%
          pull(KEGG_ID)

        # Detected KEGG repertoires
        P1 <- proteins_long %>%
          filter(Group == g1, Module == mod) %>%
          pull(KEGG_ID)

        P2 <- proteins_long %>%
          filter(Group == g2, Module == mod) %>%
          pull(KEGG_ID)


        # Only KEGG functions expressed in at least one group
        expressed <- union(P1, P2)


        tibble(
          KEGG_ID = expressed
        ) %>%
          mutate(

            Encoded_Group1 = KEGG_ID %in% G1,
            Encoded_Group2 = KEGG_ID %in% G2,

            Detected_Group1 = KEGG_ID %in% P1,
            Detected_Group2 = KEGG_ID %in% P2,

            Category = case_when(

              Encoded_Group1 &
                Encoded_Group2 &
                Detected_Group1 &
                Detected_Group2 ~
                "Shared + detected in both",

              Encoded_Group1 &
                Encoded_Group2 &
                xor(
                  Detected_Group1,
                  Detected_Group2
                ) ~
                "Shared + detected in one group only",

              TRUE ~
                "Unique + detected"
            ),

            Comparison = paste0(
              g1,
              "–",
              g2
            ),

            Module = mod
          )
      }
    )
  )
}


overlap_detail <- bind_rows(

  compare_pair(
    "Oligotroph",
    "Intermediate"
  ),

  compare_pair(
    "Oligotroph",
    "Copiotroph"
  ),

  compare_pair(
    "Intermediate",
    "Copiotroph"
  )
)


############################################################
# 7) COUNTS AND FRACTIONS
############################################################

overlap_summary <- overlap_detail %>%
  count(
    Comparison,
    Module,
    Category,
    name = "KEGG_Count"
  ) %>%
  complete(
    Comparison,
    Module,
    Category = c(
      "Shared + detected in both",
      "Shared + detected in one group only",
      "Unique + detected"
    ),
    fill = list(
      KEGG_Count = 0
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    Comparison,
    Module
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Total_Expressed_KEGGs =
      sum(KEGG_Count),

    Fraction =
      KEGG_Count /
      Total_Expressed_KEGGs,

    Percentage =
      100 * Fraction
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


############################################################
# 8) PREPARE PLOT
#
# Unique + detected is NOT plotted.
# It therefore appears as white space up to 100%.
############################################################

plot_df <- overlap_summary %>%
  filter(
    Category != "Unique + detected"
  ) %>%
  mutate(

    Comparison = factor(
      Comparison,
      levels = comparison_order
    ),

    Module = factor(
      Module,
      levels = modules_focus
    ),

    # Blue first in legend.
    # Default ggplot stacking then places yellow at bottom
    # and blue on top.
    Category = factor(
      Category,
      levels = c(
        "Shared + detected in both",
        "Shared + detected in one group only"
      )
    )
  )


############################################################
# 9) FIGURE
############################################################

Functional_Overlap_KEGG <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = Module,
    y = Fraction,
    fill = Category
  )
) +

  geom_col(
    width = 0.72
  ) +

  facet_grid(
    . ~ Comparison
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Shared + detected in both" =
        ColorPalette[2],

      "Shared + detected in one group only" =
        ColorPalette[4]
    ),
    breaks = c(
      "Shared + detected in both",
      "Shared + detected in one group only"
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(
      0,
      1,
      by = 0.2
    ),
    labels = percent_format(
      accuracy = 1
    ),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +

  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Fraction of expressed KEGG annotation functions"
  ) +

  theme_classic(
    base_size = 10
  ) +

  theme(

    strip.background =
      element_blank(),

    strip.text =
      element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 10
      ),

    axis.text.x =
      element_text(
        angle = 30,
        hjust = 1,
        vjust = 1,
        size = 8,
        color = "black"
      ),

    axis.text.y =
      element_text(
        size = 9,
        color = "black"
      ),

    axis.title.y =
      element_text(
        size = 10,
        color = "black"
      ),

    legend.position =
      "top",

    legend.justification =
      "center",

    legend.direction =
      "horizontal",

    legend.text =
      element_text(
        size = 8
      ),

    panel.spacing =
      unit(
        0.8,
        "lines"
      )
  )


print(
  Functional_Overlap_KEGG
)


############################################################
# 10) SAVE FIGURE
############################################################

ggsave(
  filename =
    "FunctionalOverlap_KEGG_TrophicStrategies.png",

  plot =
    Functional_Overlap_KEGG,

  width =
    12,

  height =
    5,

  units =
    "in",

  dpi =
    600,

  bg =
    "white"
)


############################################################
# 11) SOURCE DATA — SUPPLEMENTARY FIGURE 31
############################################################

source_dir <- paste0(
  "C:/SynologyDrive/PhD/Projects/SpringBloom2021/",
  "DataAnalysis_SpringBloom2021/Source_Data_Supplement"
)


Suppl_Figure_31 <- overlap_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Comparison = factor(
      Comparison,
      levels = comparison_order
    ),

    Module = factor(
      Module,
      levels = modules_focus
    ),

    Category = factor(
      Category,
      levels = c(
        "Shared + detected in both",
        "Shared + detected in one group only",
        "Unique + detected"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Comparison,
    Module,
    Category
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    # ASCII-safe labels for CSV export
    Comparison = str_replace_all(
      as.character(Comparison),
      "[–—]",
      "-"
    ),

    Module = as.character(Module),
    Category = as.character(Category),

    KEGG_Count,
    Total_Expressed_KEGGs,
    Fraction,
    Percentage
  )


write_csv(
  Suppl_Figure_31,
  file.path(
    source_dir,
    "Suppl_Figure_31.csv"
  )
)
```
